ABOUT OUR COMMUNITY

MORE THAN A CLUB.

ESEN Microsoft Club is a student-driven community built around technology, learning and collaboration. Members get the opportunity to develop technical skills, work on projects, attend workshops, organize events and grow through real responsibilities.

Community Mindset

"Students building, learning and growing together." We focus on hands-on creation rather than passive learning.

STRUCTURE & TEAMS

DEPARTMENTS

Four ways to contribute. One community to grow with.

The Project Department turns ideas into working products. Members collaborate on technical challenges, build digital experiences for internal club needs or campus projects, and learn software practices through real hands-on execution.

What You Might Do:

  • Develop web applications using modern front-end & back-end stacks
  • Prototype internal club digital tools and hackathon platforms
  • Collaborate in version control workflows using GitHub
  • Ship real software products alongside peer developers

Talent Acquisition focuses on discovering potential and helping members acquire crucial hard and soft skills. This department organizes weekly training sessions led by experienced ESEN students and connects members with workshops.

What You Might Do:

  • Coordinate weekly training curriculum and bootcamps
  • Identify technical talent and mentor incoming club members
  • Facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions across various tech tracks
  • Organize skill assessments and member onboarding

The Marketing Department shapes how EMC communicates visually and conceptually. From event visual identities and posters to social media campaigns, this creative team ensures all club activities stand out on campus and online.

What You Might Do:

  • Design brand identities and posters for events like Coding Universe
  • Produce video content, photos, and digital campaign assets
  • Manage community social channels and editorial publishing
  • Develop creative communication strategies for student outreach

Focusing on business thinking and innovation, the Entrepreneurship Department helps members transform technical projects into real opportunities. It fosters a startup mindset, pitching techniques, and partnership logistics.

What You Might Do:

  • Frame technical projects into pitch-ready product concepts
  • Establish relationships with external sponsors and partners
  • Organize pitch sessions and entrepreneurship workshops
  • Develop strategic planning for major club events

NOT SURE WHERE YOU FIT?

You don't need to have everything figured out right away. Explore. Try. Build. Learn.
